# JivoChat

> > JivoChat is an omnichannel live chat and customer communication platform integrating WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and other messaging channels with AI-powered chatbots, CRM, and business automation tools.

JivoChat provides a unified platform for customer support and engagement across multiple channels including live chat, messaging apps, phone, and video. The platform combines real-time communication with AI automation, CRM capabilities, and team collaboration features for businesses of all sizes.

## Key Topics

- Live Chat Software
- Omnichannel Support
- WhatsApp Integration
- Chatbots
- AI Agent
- CRM
- Customer Communication
- Telegram Integration
- Facebook Integration
- Instagram Integration
- VoIP Telephony
- Video Calls
- Mobile SDK
- Team Chat
- Lead Generation

## Core Platform

- [JivoChat Home](https://www.jivochat.com): JivoChat homepage: omnichannel live chat with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram integration
- [Features](https://www.jivochat.com/features): JivoChat core features: live chat, chatbot, mobile apps, analytics, contact collection
- [CRM](https://www.jivochat.com/crm): JivoChat CRM for sales automation with multi-channel messaging and deal tracking

## AI & Automation

- [AI Agent](https://www.jivochat.com/ai-agent): AI Agent from Jivo automates first-line support with instant responses and cost reduction
- [AI Assistant](https://www.jivochat.com/ai-assistant): JivoChat AI Assistant powered by OpenAI for faster support team response generation
- [Chatbots](https://www.jivochat.com/chatbots): JivoChat chatbot creation and multi-channel integration for sales and support automation
- [Jivo Marketing](https://www.jivochat.com/jivo-marketing): Jivo Marketing tools for lead generation with chat campaigns and popup windows

## Messaging & Channel Integration

- [WhatsApp Integration](https://www.jivochat.com/whatsapp): WhatsApp integration with JivoChat CRM for omnichannel customer engagement and messaging
- [Instagram Integration](https://www.jivochat.com/instagram): Instagram Business integration with JivoChat for unified customer support and chatbots
- [Facebook Integration](https://www.jivochat.com/facebook): Facebook and Telegram integration with JivoChat for multi-channel omnichannel support
- [Telegram Integration](https://www.jivochat.com/telegram): Telegram integration with JivoChat for customer messaging, chatbots, and CRM integration
- [Viber Integration](https://www.jivochat.com/viber): Viber integration with JivoChat for omnichannel messaging and 24/7 customer support
- [Apple Business Chat](https://www.jivochat.com/business-chat): Apple Business Chat and iMessage integration with Apple Pay for iOS customer messaging
- [Email Integration](https://www.jivochat.com/email): JivoChat email integration for unified inbox and customer communication management

## Communication Features

- [Telephony Plus](https://www.jivochat.com/telephony_module): JivoChat Telephony Plus: IP telephony with call recording and website call integration
- [Business Phone](https://www.jivochat.com/telephony): JivoChat Business Phone: VoIP service with virtual PBX, SMS, and call management
- [Video Calls](https://www.jivochat.com/video_calls): JivoChat Video Calls for browser-based visual communication and sales conversion
- [Callback Feature](https://www.jivochat.com/calls): JivoChat callback feature for phone-based customer engagement and conversion optimization

## Mobile & Deployment

- [Mobile SDK](https://www.jivochat.com/mobilesdk): JivoChat Mobile SDK for iOS and Android app integration with chatbot and push notifications

## Team & Collaboration

- [Team Chat](https://www.jivochat.com/teamchats): JivoChat Team Chat for internal business communication and employee collaboration
